args: credential_file="$HOME/.pluglayer/credentials.env"; if [ -r "$credential_file" ]; then . "$credential_file"; if [ -z "${PLUGLAYER_API_KEY:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'PlugLayer MCP authentication is empty. Update the saved token, then reload Cursor.' >&2; exit 78; fi; export PLUGLAYER_CREDENTIALS_FILE="$credential_file"; unset PLUGLAYER_API_KEY PLUGLAYER_API_URL; elif [ -z "${PLUGLAYER_API_KEY:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'PlugLayer MCP authentication is not configured. Run the PlugLayer installer or export PLUGLAYER_API_KEY, then reload Cursor.' >&2; exit 78; fi; exec uvx pluglayer-mcp
